name: PathUSD
oneLiner: pathUSD is Tempo's quote stablecoin; mint via USDC deposit and redeem through Bridge into a reserve of cash, short Treasuries, repo, and MMF exposure.
collateral: Bridge-managed reserve assets for Tempo pathUSD, including cash, short-dated Treasuries, overnight Treasury repo, and money-market-fund exposure
pegMechanism: Tempo users mint pathUSD by depositing USDC.e through Bridge-supported exchange flows and redeem pathUSD back into USDC through Bridge rails

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Bridge documents pathUSD issuance and redemption through its stablecoin rail against reserves of cash, short Treasuries, overnight Treasury repo, and money-market-fund exposure. The holder receives a par issuer redemption claim rather than a fund share or collateralized borrower position, so fiat-cash is the closest archetype.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bridge issuance FAQ (no published pathUSD reserve report; the FAQ's quarterly audit statement is forward-looking only - same posture as the corrected usdsui-sui record)

applicabilityBasis.summary: pathUSD functions as Tempo routing and quote-token infrastructure; its payment-stablecoin treatment remains less clear than consumer-facing Bridge issued stablecoins.

genius.issuerEntity: Bridge Building Inc. (USDB/stablecoin issuer; a subsidiary of Bridge Ventures LLC — the Stripe-owned Delaware entity and OCC national trust bank charter applicant)
genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (conditional trust charter, Feb 2026); FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators (current)
genius.notes: Bridge (OCC filing ID 343543) received conditional approval for a federally chartered national trust bank on Feb 12, 2026 — the same track as Circle, Ripple, Paxos, BitGo, and Fidelity Digital Assets. This is a trust charter conditional approval under existing OCC authority, not a PPSI approval under the GENIUS Act; the PPSI application framework itself remains in proposed-rulemaking. Bridge publicly describes its stack as GENIUS Act-ready. pathUSD is Tempo's TIP-20 quote token issued via Bridge infrastructure; no token-specific GENIUS authorization was located.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official GENIUS Act application was located for pathUSD or Bridge; the OCC conditional trust charter is a separate pre-existing pathway. No PPSI approval has been granted to any issuer as of 2026-06-18.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Tempo block 30043787, pathUSD reported paused() = false and transferPolicyId() = 2. The TIP-20 specification and implementation grant PAUSE_ROLE the ability to halt transfers, allow DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to replace the transfer policy, and grant BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE the ability to burn tokens from accounts blocked by the active policy. The current unpaused state does not remove those privileged transfer-control paths, so direct restriction/freeze capability is established.

notices.title: Tempo-native issuer rail
notices.message: pathUSD is tracked as a Tempo quote token. Pharos models its Bridge redemption route, but there is no independent live reserve adapter for the Bridge reserve portfolio yet.

mintAuthority.summary: At Tempo block 32028752, pathUSD issuance proxy 0x8354d80eea9978faa04c3b36771c1e8b9c3e9058 remains a UUPS proxy (implementation 0x271c4d8616ed81c2cc006446c61f25219b182f8a; EIP-1967 admin slot zero). Its sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member 0x79c6631fa15cda38777fb9dd7a6348baee794a4e authorizes upgradeToAndCall, so mint logic is changeable. The same proxy holds ISSUER_ROLE on the pathUSD TIP-20 token and mints within the 100 million supply cap.

controls.label: pathUSD active TIP-20 issuer proxy
controls.capDescription: At the observation block, supplyCap() was 100,000,000 pathUSD. This proxy held ISSUER_ROLE but not DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it could mint only within the current cap and could not raise it directly.
controls.evidence: At Tempo block 30043787, public RPC returned hasRole(proxy, ISSUER_ROLE) = true and hasRole(proxy, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) = false. An RPC trace of transaction 0xbf824b6afb9ce9379fbea4337c51562560d577dd91237d4a35794daa5528de9a shows this proxy calling pathUSD.mint(). Its EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0x271c4d8616ed81c2cc006446c61f25219b182f8a.

controls.label: pathUSD issuer proxy DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (UUPS upgrader)
controls.evidence: At Tempo block 32028752, dual public RPCs (rpc.tempo.xyz and tempo.drpc.org) agreed: issuer proxy EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x271c4d8616ed81c2cc006446c61f25219b182f8a, admin slot = 0x0, UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() = 5.0.0, supportsInterface(AccessControlEnumerable)=true, getRoleMemberCount(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)=1, getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,0)=0x79c6631fa15cda38777fb9dd7a6348baee794a4e, and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, that address)=true. eth_call upgradeToAndCall(currentImpl, 0x) from a non-admin reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(caller, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x0); the same call from 0x79c6631f… returns success with no state change. No on-chain upgrade delay was observed (delaySec=0). Account bytecode is EIP-7702 designator 0xef0100||0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b (not a Safe; getOwners/getThreshold empty), so authorityType remains eoa with a present 7702 delegation module rather than a verified multisig threshold.

review.evidence: 2026-07-27/28 upgrade-authority re-read resolves the prior canChangeMintLogic=unknown gap. At Tempo block 32028752, independent RPCs rpc.tempo.xyz and tempo.drpc.org both show issuer proxy 0x8354d80eea9978faa04c3b36771c1e8b9c3e9058 as UUPS (EIP-1967 impl 0x271c4d8616ed81c2cc006446c61f25219b182f8a, admin slot zero, UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0, implementation proxiableUUID = EIP-1967 impl slot). AccessControlEnumerable role introspection on the proxy returns a single DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member 0x79c6631fa15cda38777fb9dd7a6348baee794a4e. Live upgradeToAndCall simulation proves that role is the authorize path: non-members revert with AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount needing role 0x0; the admin member succeeds. No timelock delay is present on that path. The admin account carries EIP-7702 delegated code to 0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b without Safe getOwners/getThreshold, so threshold/signer composition is not claimed. Prior issuance facts retained: at block 30043787 the proxy held ISSUER_ROLE (not DEFAULT_ADMIN on the token mint path as minter), supply cap 100,000,000 pathUSD, canRaiseCap=false for the direct minter, economicCapSemantics bounded. Verified Solidity source for the issuer implementation remains unpublished (Sourcify no-match); authorization is established from on-chain role + UUPS call behavior rather than source.
